items.title: 68514_Horace Henderson oral history interview
items.q: I know them real well as if it were yesterday... Coleman Hawkins played the saxophone... and Buster Bailey played the tenor... Then he had Kayser Marshall on the drums... we used to go up and have jam sessions at his apartment... this constituted the fellas in Fletcher's band, of course... Buster Ba

ctx.x: The only experience that I got which I was gonna get to -- every summer I would look forward to going to New York, and I would go right to the Roseland, I'd sit right by my brother on the stand and pick up pointers and things to go back to school in September again. And he would help me out this way, and I would watch every guy. I had my notebook and everything -- would watch the way his original guys did. You know the original band that Fletcher had consisted of Don Redman, Coleman Hawkins, and Buster Bailey.…
